text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
choice_data_list: I was worried. Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
A-Actually... my lucky item from this 
morning's horoscope was a pink car.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
So I figured I'd casually look around 
while I was out anyway, but...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, it had gotten this 
late... I will make sure this does not 
happen again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's fine to lose yourself in what you 
love, but that aside, I gave her a stern 
talking-to for being late.
